title: Choose Jiaming Zhang's visual world
question: Keep the traceable personal folio, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Traceable Folio
options.lineage: annotated RFCs, review markup, engineering audit trails, personal technical papers
options.thesis: A personal document whose visible hand-drawn trace connects each claim to the work and judgment behind it.
options.viewport: A quiet nameplate and line-art portrait open into one confident statement; a hand-drawn trace leaves the portrait, underlines the statement, and becomes the first project diagram.
options.risk: The trace becomes a gimmick if it decorates every paragraph instead of carrying real relationships.

options.label: The Exposed Binding
options.lineage: Coptic books with visible chain-stitch spines and pages that open fully flat
options.thesis: Nothing is hidden: one visible binding links experience, work, thinking, and future writing into a growing personal volume.
options.viewport: A flat-open title spread places the portrait as a bookplate while a stitched vertical index reveals every section of the site.
options.risk: The literal book mechanism may make an engineer's living profile feel like a craft portfolio or a finished memoir.
options.case: Audience identification is strong and personal; product clarity is slightly weaker because the binding metaphor can lead the content.

options.label: The Comparative Folio
options.lineage: botanical folios that compare fixed-scale plates with captions and annotations
options.thesis: Work is examined as a series of comparable plates, each showing the problem, intervention, evidence, and lasting lesson at one shared scale.
options.viewport: The portrait and three tiny work plates share one baseline; hovering or focusing a plate reveals the decision that changed the outcome.
options.risk: The organic specimen metaphor can falsely imply that a career follows neat natural stages.
options.case: Fuses well with diagrams and low contrast, but identifies Jiaming less clearly as an engineer than the traceable folio.

canonCard.label: The polished portfolio standard
canonCard.thesis: A familiar hero, experience list, project cards, stack, and contact block executed with excellent typography.
canonCard.viewport: Name, role statement, short introduction, contact action, and the first experience row appear in a predictable reading order.
canonCard.risk: It is clear and usable but does not express how Jiaming connects work, evidence, and thought.
